<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/auth/setup/restore-backup"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



First-run only: public, and refused with `409` once the server has any
account. Restores one of the backups listed by
`GET /api/auth/setup/backups`, chosen by file name.

A **zip** is restored like an uploaded export: every row with its
original id, settings minus credentials, and media — files the zip
doesn't contain are taken from media storage, or else copied from the
backups volume's mirror (including its `.deleted/` folders); if any is
missing from both, `400` with `missingMedia` and nothing is written. A
Famlin backup (format 2) restores every account with its password, so
`admin` is optional and without it no session is issued. An older
export without credentials, or a backup without any admin account,
needs `admin` (`400` with `code: restoreAdminRequired` otherwise).

A **dump** replaces the whole database through pg_restore (as
`POST /api/auth/setup/restore-dump`), then every file in the mirror
that media storage lacks is copied back. Sessions issued before any
restore no longer work. Rate-limited to 5 requests per 15 minutes per IP.
